text:
Sorry the replacement didn't make it. Yes, you may be eligible for another one.

- **New guarantee:** A replacement plant gets its own 30-day guarantee, counted from when the replacement was delivered. If it died within that window, it can be replaced once more.
- **How to claim:** Go to "My Orders" and submit a claim with at least two photos, one of the whole plant and one close-up. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days. You don't need to send the plant back.
- **What counts:** The plant needs to have died or declined significantly, meaning it lost more than a third of its leaves, has stem or root rot, or collapsed. The usual exclusions still apply, such as pests introduced after delivery, deliberate neglect, or repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days.
- **Last replacement:** The plant sent as this second replacement won't have a guarantee.

If you're past the 30 days since the replacement was delivered, I can't promise a replacement, but I can escalate your case to a Support Lead.

A Plant Care Specialist can also give you free care advice by chat or email, which might help the next plant do better.
